entities.name: Zagreb–Belgrade railway
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Zagreb–Belgrade railway was the Yugoslav Railways′ 412-kilometre (256 mi) long railway line connecting the cities of Zagreb and Belgrade in SR Croatia and SR Serbia, at the time of the SFR Yugoslavia.
